summary_up_top.suggest: The opening should immediately state that this is a companion reference listing all 314 HSN codes mapped to technical-textile segments for the main Fuel to Fibre article.

edits.why: Navigation elements, text sizing tools, audio players, and breadcrumbs clutter the mobile view before the actual content starts.
edits.how: Strip out the site navigation, text size controls, listen buttons, and breadcrumbs so the article title is the first thing visible.

edits.why: Thirteen massive data tables in a row create an endless scroll that overwhelms mobile screens and breaks browser performance.
edits.how: Collapse each segment into a summary accordion or collapsible list view rather than rendering all 314 rows across 13 tables simultaneously.

edits.why: Burying nearly 400 words of methodology and caveats at the very bottom after an endless wall of data tables means readers miss crucial context.
edits.how: Move the Methodology & caveats section up right after 'What this is' so readers understand the data rules before browsing the codes.

edits.how: Insert a new H2 titled "Summary" right after the first line of the opening and before the "What this is" section, containing 2‑3 concise sentences.

edits.why: The opening block is a wall of text that scrolls off‑screen on mobile.
edits.how: Break the opening after the sentence ending with "...crowding the main piece." and start a new paragraph with the next sentence.

edits.why: An introductory heading helps readers understand the purpose before the long series of tables.
